input.content:
# sdr-2 insights — story/session state-dir adoption

- **`hive/lib/package.json` `"type": "module"` (added in sdr-1) latently broke the
  whole CJS session stack**, not just config.js. `session-registry.js`,
  `session-episode-writer.js`, and `session-client.js` were all un-loadable
  (`require is not defined in ES module scope`) — `tests/hive-lib/session-registry.cc-session-id.test.js`
  and `session-client.runtime-fork.test.js` fail 7/7 and 6/6 on the epic branch
  *before* any sdr-2 change. I converted the two files in this story's scope to
  ESM (named exports preserved; `require(esm)` verified for `session-invoke.mjs`'s
  `createRequire` path). **`session-client.js` is still CJS-broken** — whoever
  touches it next must do the same conversion; its tests will stay red until then.

- **Resolve default paths per call, not at module load.** The old
  `REGISTRY_PATH`/`EPISODES_BASE` constants froze `process.cwd()` at import time.
  Using default-parameter expressions (`registryPath = defaultRegistryPath()`)
  re-evaluates the resolver each call, so `HIVE_STATE_DIR`/`hive.config.yaml`/cwd
  are honored at write time and tests can chdir without module-cache tricks.

- **`findRepoRoot` probes must include `hive.config.yaml`.** When the state tree
  is relocated, `.pHive` no longer exists at the project root, so a `.pHive`-only
  ancestor walk silently falls back to the plugin install dir. Probe for the
  config file first, keep `.pHive` as the legacy marker.

- **Tests asserting resolver output must `realpathSync` their temp dirs** —
  macOS `os.tmpdir()` is `/var/...` → `/private/var/...` and the sdr-1 resolver
  symlink-canonicalizes, so un-canonicalized `mkdtempSync` paths fail equality
  asserts.

- Pre-existing quirk (not fixed, out of scope): `session-registry.acquireLock`
  burns its full 10×100ms retry budget and fails open when the `sessions/` dir
  doesn't exist yet, because the lock sentinel `writeFileSync(..., wx)` ENOENTs —
  only `writeRegistry` creates the dir. Each first-write to a fresh state dir
  costs ~1s.
